rules.description: MX Master: Map Thumb Button (Cmd+Tab) to Mission Control
Cmd+Q requires a 'Hold' and only triggers ONCE
Home row mods - ctrl, opt, cmd, shift
Dygma Defy: Map Home/End to Command+Left/Right (supports Shift)
Modifiers+Left/Right Arrows Cycle (Command => Option => Control => Command)
Cmd = Delete Word | Ctrl = Delete Line (Forward/Backward, except Finder)
